about: Provenance lock for vendored skills. Each entry pins the upstream commit and the sha256 of the file as vendored. Verify with `python scripts/verify-skills-lock.py` (CI gate); refresh with --update.
hashCaveat: computedHash in version 1 of this file matched no upstream revision of any of these files and no normalisation of them, so it could not be verified at all. Version 2 records what sha256 actually covers.
